title: A scheme point has a monomorphic residue-field representative
statement: Let $U$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $u\in U$ a point with residue field $\kappa(u)$ [def-weil-residue-field]. The canonical morphism $i_u:\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(u)\to U$ of [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-from-spec-field, def-weil-affine-spectrum] is a monomorphism of schemes: for every scheme $T$ and morphisms $a,b:T\to\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(u)$, the equality $i_u\circ a=i_u\circ b$ implies $a=b$. No closedness or local-closedness assumption on $u$ is imposed.
